regulations.full_title: Standard Specification for Infrared Thermometers for Intermittent Determination of Patient Temperature

intended_use_items.description: The Infrared No-Touch Forehead Thermometer is intended for the intermittent measurement of body temperature from the forehead skin surface on people of all ages.
intended_use_items.use_environment: Household environment and by healthcare providers

tests.name: ASTM E1965-98 (2023) Full Evaluation
tests.verdict: The test item passed the test specification(s). All applicable test objects meet the requirement.

semantic_fragments.content: All the requirements of ASTM E 1965-98(2016) were evaluated in this test report except the following clauses: 5.5.1 Clinical Accuracy is not evaluated in this report. 5.9.1 Housing Materials is not evaluated in this report. 6.2 Clinical Accuracy Tests. Condition of acceptability: 1) 5.5.1 Clinical Accuracy is not evaluated in this report. 2) 5.9.1 Housing Materials is not evaluated in this report. 3) 6.2 Clinical Accuracy Tests.

The test results presented in this report relate only to the object tested. Without permission of the Report department this test report is not permitted to be duplicated in extracts. This report shall not be reproduced except in full without the written approval of the testing laboratory. List of test equipment must be kept on file and available for review.

Possible test case verdicts: N/A - test case does not apply to the test object; Pass (P) - test object does meet the requirement; N/E - test object was not evaluated for the requirement. Throughout this report a comma/point is used as the decimal separator. '(see Attachment #)' refers to additional information appended to the report. '(see appended table)' refers to a table appended to the report.
